zh: 支持独立着色器包 (Shaderpacks)：内置 [Vanilla PT] 和 [Advanced] 版本，支持基础路径追踪、法线贴图、视差映射、焦散水体、ReSTIR 直接光采样（仅限 Advanced）、体积光/云及动态模糊
新增用于直接光采样的区块发光收集：详情参阅 Advanced Shaderpack 及手册
多线程增强区块加载性能
材质包重载速度显著提升 (达 3 倍)
显著减少 RAM 与 VRAM 占用
大幅缩短管线重建时间
修复大量已知细节 Bug
en: Supports individual shaderpacks: Features internal [Vanilla PT] and [Advanced] versions with basic path tracing, normal mapping, parallax, realistic water (caustics), ReSTIR (Advanced only), volumetric light/cloud, and motion blur
Added chunk emission collection for direct light sampling: See Advanced Shaderpack and manual for details
Enhanced chunk loading with multi-threading
Significantly enhanced texturepack reload speed (3x)
Significantly reduced RAM and VRAM usage
Significantly reduced pipeline recreation time
Fixed a lot of small bugs
Port for 1.21.1 and 1.20.1 is coming soon

zh: 重写管线设置：新增预设模式以简化设置，并添加默认模块位置以避免模块重叠
简化 labPBR 纹理加载（无需预处理）
增强色调映射 (Tone Mapping)：添加中心模式（基于准星周围像素）和全局模式，增加更多映射方法并公开更多设置
集成 Nvidia SHaRC 和 XeSS SR（仅限 Windows）
改进光线追踪模块：公开部分 RT 着色器以供运行时修改（实验性），优化内部着色器以减少寄存器和 SM 使用，分离反射和折射路径
重写 NRD 模块：遵循 NRD 示例，改进 Reblur 反射效果，公开几乎所有 ReBlur 设置
添加基础发光纹理支持
问题修复：修复特定时间纯黑、宽字符路径、DLSS 模式设置、追踪路径中的选择框/碰撞框、不正确的 labPBR 解码、手部渲染异常、Vulkan 纹理格式、模块偏移、内存泄漏以及草方块侧面生物群系纹理丢失等问题
移除对 DLSS 的硬性依赖（若缺少 DLSS 库将默认使用 NRD）
en: Pipeline settings rewrite: Add preset mode for simplified settings and default module position to avoid overlap
Simplified labPBR texture load (No pre-process is necessary)
Tone mapping enhanced: Add center mode (based on crosshair pixels) and global mode, more mapping methods and exposed settings
Integrated Nvidia SHaRC and XeSS SR (Windows only)
Ray Tracing module improved: Dynamic shader modification (experimental), optimized internal shaders, and split reflection/refraction paths
Rewrite NRD module: Following NRD sample, improved reflections with Reblur, exposed more settings
Add basic emission textures

Bug fixes: Pure black screen, wide character paths, DLSS mode settings, selection/hit box in tracing path, labPBR decode, hand rendering, Vulkan texture format, module shift, memory leakage, and biome textures
Removed hard dependency on DLSS (defaults to NRD if libs are absent)

zh: 新增具有模块化渲染块的动态管线
解决 CPU 瓶颈问题（现在性能提升 1.5 倍）
修复 UI 显示问题
支持 PBR 材质包
更新至最新 DLSS 版本
增加实验性的 NRD 和 FSR3 支持 (全显卡厂商兼容)
修复发光粒子显示异常的 Bug
修复粒子穿墙（角落）的 Bug
修复旗帜和盾牌图案显示不正确的 Bug
修复船只渲染不正确的 Bug
修复末地传送门和折跃门显示为纯灰色的 Bug
en: Added dynamic pipeline with modularized render blocks
Solved CPU bottleneck issue (1.5x performance gain now)
UI issues solved
PBR texture packs supported
Updated to the latest DLSS version
Added experimental NRD and FSR3 support (Cross-Vendor compatible)
Fixed the bug where glowing particles appear problematic
Fixed the bug where the particles get through at the corners
Fixed the bug where the banner and shield patterns are not displayed correctly
Fixed the bug where the boats are not rendered correctly
Fixed the bug where the end portal and gateway are pure gray

zh: 新增截图功能
调整曝光算法，提高对高亮区域的灵敏度，减少过度曝光
en: Screenshot functionality is now available
Tuned the exposure algorithm for better sensitivity to bright areas, leading to less over-exposure

zh: 修复了移动时的画面回闪问题
en: Fixed the issue of frame flashback when moving

zh: 首个公开预览版，开启次世代光影体验
完整的 Vulkan 渲染后端实现
基础 hardware 光线追踪管线与路径追踪支持,加入 DLSS 4.5 支持
en: First public preview version
Full Vulkan rendering backend implementation
Basic hardware Ray Tracing, and path tracing support. Features DLSS 4.5.
